name: application-exception
description: Typed failures and deliberate disclosure for TypeScript services and LLM harnesses.

scripts.test:runtimes: npm run test:node-esm && npm run test:bun && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:all: npm test -- --runInBand --coverage && npm run test:types && npm run build && npm run test:package && npm run test:runtimes && npm run docs:check
scripts.prepublish-me: npm run prepare-me && rm -fr ./npm-module-build && mkdir -p ./npm-module-build/docs/agent ./npm-module-build/docs/design ./npm-module-build/schemas && cp -R ./dist/. ./npm-module-build && cp package.json README.md CHANGELOG.md LICENSE AGENTS.md ./npm-module-build && cp docs/agent/*.md ./npm-module-build/docs/agent && cp docs/design/*.md ./npm-module-build/docs/design && cp docs/runtime-support.md ./npm-module-build/docs && cp schemas/*.json ./npm-module-build/schemas
scripts.publish-me: npm run prepublish-me && cd npm-module-build && npm publish --access public --registry https://registry.npmjs.org/
scripts.test-ci: npm test -- --runInBand --ci --coverage && npm run test:types && npm run build && npm run test:package && npm run test:node-esm && npm run docs:check

author: Dany Fedorov
